privacy.title: Privacy Policy

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.p1: To provide the service, we collect the following information:

li1.text: Nick, age, email address or phone number.

li2.text: Photos, bio, height, weight and role preferences.

li3.text: Your precise geolocation while the app is in use and you have visibility enabled.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
section2.li1: Show you on the map to other nearby users.
section2.li2: Allow other users to see your profile and communicate with you.
section2.li3: Manage your Premium subscription and process payments.
section2.li4: Improve and protect the security of the application.

section3.title: 3. Information Sharing
section3.p1: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Your profile information and location are visible to other application users according to your visibility settings.

section4.title: 4. Your Rights
section4.p1: You can access, correct or delete your data at any time from your profile settings. If you delete your account, your personal data will be immediately erased from our active servers.

section5.title: 5. Security
section5.p1: We implement security measures to protect your data, including encryption and firewalls on our Firebase (Google Cloud) infrastructure.

section6.title: 6. Cookies and Local Storage
section6.p1: We use local storage on your device to keep you logged in and remember your display preferences.

privacy.footer: © 2026 Blow Nights App. Your privacy is our priority.

rules.title: Community Rules
rules.subtitle: Blow Nights is a safe and real space. To keep it that way, we all follow these fundamental principles.

rule1.title: Total Respect
rule1.desc: Zero tolerance for hate, harassment or discrimination. We treat others how we want to be treated. Manners are the foundation of any connection.

rule2.title: Authenticity
rule2.desc: No landscape photos, celebrities or fake profiles. We want to see you. Honesty in your profile is what builds real trust.

rule3.title: Privacy
rule3.desc: Respect the private album of others. Consent is sacred. What happens in chats stays in chats. We take care of your data.

rule4.title: Security
rule4.desc: Only for those 18 and older. If you see something suspicious, report it immediately. Our team manually reviews every report in less than 24h.

rules.report_desc: Use the report button on any user's profile. Block instantly if you feel uncomfortable. Your well-being is our number one priority.

terms.title: Terms of Service

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.p1: By accessing or using Blow Nights, you agree to be legally bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you should not use the application.

section2.title: 2. Age Requirements
section2.p1: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account and use Blow Nights. The use of the application by minors is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate account deletion.

section3.title: 3. User Conduct
section3.p1: You commit to using the application respectfully. It is prohibited to:
section3.li1: Harass, intimidate or defame other users.
section3.li2: Post illegal, obscene, pornographic (without consent) or hateful content.
section3.li4: Use the application for unauthorized commercial purposes or spam.

section4.title: 4. Geolocation and Privacy
section4.p1: Blow Nights is a location-based app. By turning on your visibility, you share your approximate location with other users. You understand and accept that this is the core functionality of the app.

section5.title: 5. Premium Subscriptions
section5.p1: Premium subscriptions grant access to additional features. Payments are processed through third-party providers (Stripe). Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled before the end of the current period.

section6.title: 6. Account Termination
section6.p1: We reserve the right to suspend or delete any account that violates these terms or for any other reason we deem necessary to maintain community safety.

terms.footer: © 2026 Blow Nights App. All rights reserved.

master_partner.no_cities: No cities assigned to your territory.
master_partner.central_desc: Retained by the platform. Covers technology, support, infrastructure and development.
master_partner.mp_desc: Your retention for managing the agent network. 10% management + 5% contributed by HQ.
master_partner.agent_desc: To distribute among your local agents according to the agreements you maintain with them.
master_partner.note_text: The platform transfers 55% in a single Stripe payment to your account. The internal distribution to your agents (40%) is your responsibility and is not recorded on the platform.
master_partner.no_agents_desc: Add your first agent to generate venue acquisition links.
master_partner.team_note_text: Each agent gets a unique link. When a venue signs up through that link, the acquisition is automatically attributed to the agent. You manage payments to your agents outside the platform.
master_partner.no_subagents_desc: Generate custom codes and links for your street sales team. Every captured venue will be immutably attributed to your account and their sub-agent.
master_partner.blackbox_text: Blow Nights settles the territorial split (50/50) entirely to your Stripe Connect account. Internal agreements, percentages and payments with your sub-agents or street salespeople are exclusively your responsibility as the city's Master Partner.
master_partner.whatsapp_venue_invite: Hi, here's the official link to register your venue on Blow Nights. From there you can create your venue profile and access event, promotion, and ticketing tools:
master_partner.no_venues_desc: Venues captured by your sub-agents will appear here with their subscription status.

landing_hero_description: Stop arriving at empty clubs or waiting 40 minutes in pointless queues. Discover which venues are peaking in real time, create meetup points (Chills) and skip tedious sign-ups.
landing_ticker_1: Kapital Madrid: Main room at 98% capacity
landing_ticker_2: Razzmatazz BCN: Last 35 tickets for tonight
landing_ticker_3: New spontaneous Chill created in Malasaña (12 people)
landing_ticker_4: Fabric London: Estimated queue under 10 min right now
landing_ticker_5: Berghain Berlin: Door & live queue status
landing_ticker_7: Mondo Disko: 14 friends checked in live
landing_bento_title: Your night shouldn't be a gamble.
landing_bento_subtitle: We combine real-time check-in data, direct ticketing and community meetup points so every outing is unforgettable.
landing_bento1_desc: Physically verified check-ins via geolocation and room scanner. Discover which venues have queues, what music is playing, and the perfect moment to arrive.
landing_bento2_desc: Buy with Apple Pay or card in seconds. Your QR code lands on your screen or email without forcing a long sign-up.
landing_bento3_desc: Create or join meetup points before or after the club. Find your musical tribe with no middlemen.
landing_bento4_desc: No fake-ticket scams or abusive resales. Every party and venue is verified through our official management panel.
landing_cities_title: Pick your city and go out tonight
landing_cities_subtitle: The radar is active 24/7 in the capitals with the strongest clubbing culture.
landing_clubbers_title: The night is too short to waste on bad decisions.
landing_clubbers_desc: Join free, check the live map on your phone and get priority access to the most exclusive events in your city.
landing_clubs_title: Fill your venue on slow nights and maximise weekends.
landing_clubs_desc: Appear as a verified venue on the radar, sell direct tickets, scan at the door with no login and attract thousands of qualified clubbers.
landing_footer_tagline: The pulse of nightlife in real time · LC-1.0 Commercial Release

business_login_register_venue_desc: Nightclub, bar, pub or event venue. Manage your presence, events and tickets.
business_login_become_cm_desc: Operate Blow Nights in your city. Venue acquisition, territory management and revenue share.
business_login_password_too_short: Password must be at least 6 characters
business_login_request_received_desc: We have received your request. Our team will review it and contact you by email within 24-48h.

chill_manage_door_link_desc: Send this link via WhatsApp to whoever controls access. They can scan without registering.
chill_manage_no_credits: You have no QR Credits. Top up to issue passes.
chill_manage_credits_coming_soon: QR credit purchases will be available soon.
landing_page_want_to_see: Want to see who's inside and send a Ping?
landing_page_partygoer_desc: Access the live map, send pings, buy VIP passes and join private Chills (User Plus) or create your own (User Black).
landing_page_club_desc: Connect your bank account in seconds, publish tickets with direct public links and control capacity in real time with magic scanners.
landing_page_cm_desc: Lead and supervise an entire city. Approve venues and events in your area while earning automatic territorial revenue.
partners_hero_desc: Dating apps and generic ticketing platforms are obsolete. Join the definitive platform that unifies social radar, ticket sales, PRs and private afters. We run the technology, you lead your city.
partners_hot_cities_title: Territories with traction ready to operate
partners_hot_cities_desc: These territories already have venues using the platform and paying their fee. Claim the territory today and start earning your margin tomorrow.
partners_engines_desc: Proven infrastructure ready to deploy in your city in 48 hours.
partners_engine1_desc: Direct online payments via Stripe. The venue issues the invoice (0 risk for you). Browser-based bouncer scanner (<300ms) with no apps or queues.
partners_engine2_desc: Free QR issuance and cash/Bizum collection without intermediation. Two-way settlement at the end of the night that avoids cash discrepancies.
partners_engine3_desc: The 05:00 AM business. Fuzzy radar of afters behind a "Hard Paywall". To see the location and chat, the user pays a VIP membership.
partners_engine4_desc: Interactive directory of clubs, cocktail bars and saunas. Real-time capacity and in-person check-in to see who is at each venue.
partners_economic_desc: A model designed so the City Manager earns through two channels: ticket commissions and user VIP subscriptions. Everything automatically settled to your bank account via Stripe.
partners_projection_desc: Profitability estimate for a city with an active nightlife circuit. A high-margin model (fee of 5,000 EUR/year) that you recover in the first quarter.
partners_footnote_tickets: *3,000 tickets/month is barely 5-8% of a capital's nightlife.
partners_launch_desc: We deliver the operating platform in your city ([city].blownights.com), linked to your Stripe account. Start by offering a "Frictionless Pilot" to venues — 100% free for the first session to prove the value.
partners_one_license: Only 1 exclusive license per metropolitan area.
partners_macro_city_q: Do you live in a major city (Madrid/Barcelona)?
partners_associated_desc: Apply for the Associated Partner role. No territorial exclusivity and no entry fee (0 EUR). Earn commission (2% + 0.10 EUR) on every ticket from the venues you onboard. Your venues get premium visibility (pinned at the top and highlighted in gold on the map).

super_admin.suspend_mp_desc: This will revoke the user's masterPartner role and block their access to the dashboard. The venues and sub-agents remain.

business_hero_badge_carta_blanca: Custom Mode: 100% adaptable to your operations
business_hero_title_lead: The platform that shapes itself around how you manage tickets, drinks, and promoters.
business_hero_subtitle_carta_blanca: You choose which services to activate, under what rules, and how you interact with the app. No lock-in, no need to swap your POS or suppliers.
business_stat_conversion: Direct sales with fair transparent fees
business_cb_title: You decide how your venue runs
business_cb_subtitle: Pick which modules to activate, combine them however you want, and define your own operating rules:
business_cb_toggle_notice: Each of these modules operates 100% standalone or seamlessly blended together.
business_mod_ticketing_tagline: Sell with your own tiers, quotas, and entry windows
business_mod_ticketing_feat1: Direct payouts into your Stripe account without unjustified holding periods.
business_mod_ticketing_feat2: Dynamic anti-copy QR tickets engineered with offline-first reliability.
business_mod_ticketing_feat3: VIP tables, bottles, and time-restricted admission tiers with custom quotas.
business_mod_ticketing_link_mode: Already using another ticketing platform? We can link out to your existing vendor cleanly.
business_mod_drinks_tagline: Eliminate bar queues and paper token fraud
business_mod_drinks_feat1: Admission-included drinks redeemed with a single screen tap at the bar.
business_mod_drinks_feat2: Digital cocktail menu and advance pre-sales for bottles and mixed drinks.
business_mod_drinks_feat3: Ultra-fast bartender scanner built for smartphones, tablets, or existing POS.
business_mod_drinks_custom: Tailor premium spirit upgrades and brand supplements directly from your stock.
business_mod_door_tagline: Scan under 0.4s without purchasing proprietary hardware
business_mod_door_feat1: Scan from any standard smartphone: onboard bouncers in seconds.
business_mod_door_feat2: Live capacity counters synced directly with your city real-time Radar.
business_mod_door_feat3: Guaranteed offline mode resilient against basement dead zones.
business_mod_door_roles: Door staff management with independent, instantly revocable access tokens.
business_mod_rrpp_tagline: Manage your internal venue sales team with verified metrics and transparent settlements
business_mod_rrpp_feat1: Unique sales tracking links for each of your in-house promoters to monitor real door conversions.
business_mod_rrpp_feat2: Automated calculation of internal commissions configured by your venue.
business_mod_rrpp_feat3: Digital door guest lists tied to your staff promoters without soggy paper printouts.
business_mod_rrpp_claim: Manage your direct promoters from your dashboard while keeping your private commercial policies.
business_radar_title: Show up right when they are deciding where to go
business_radar_desc: Nightlife crowds open Blow Nights while on the street, in a cab, or at pre-drinks deciding their next destination. When your spot is buzzing or dropping a flash deal, the Radar guides them straight to your entrance.
business_radar_fuego: Fire Alert: highlights when your dancefloor hits peak momentum
business_radar_promos: Flash Geopromos: broadcast nearby deals within a 5 km radius in minutes
business_radar_agenda: Event Agenda: prime spotlight within the city night guide
business_steps_subtitle: Zero construction, no forced lock-in, dedicated personal assistance
business_step1_desc: A quick call or WhatsApp message to understand your current setup and what you want to optimize.
business_step2_desc: We only turn on what helps you grow: bar catalog, scanner access, PR lists, or pure crowd visibility.
business_step3_desc: Run a weekend trial on the ground. If you love the flow and numbers, keep rolling with us.
business_guarantee_title: «Software that gets out of your crew’s way»
business_guarantee_desc: Bartenders and bouncers have zero patience for sluggish tools or 3-hour courses. Our mobile tools are built to fire within milliseconds under dark, loud, high-pressure club conditions.
business_cta_title: Let’s talk about your venue and what fits you best
business_cta_subtitle: Drop us a direct WhatsApp message or sign into the business dashboard in 2 minutes to test drive.
business_cb_simulate: Simulate your module combination. Click to toggle on/off.
pr_join_hero_title: You Decide Where, When and With Whom.
pr_join_hero_lead: Generate tickets, manage guest lists and earn commissions without depending on any venue.
pr_join_hero_subtitle: Blow Nights gives you your own space as a free-agent promoter. Personal sales link, real-time tracking, automatic payouts, and total freedom to work across venues and events.
pr_join_benefits_subtitle: You're not an employee. You're a free agent with professional tools.
pr_join_benefit1_desc: A unique link you can share on Instagram, WhatsApp or anywhere. Every ticket sold is automatically attributed to you.
pr_join_benefit2_desc: See how many tickets you generated, how many were scanned at the door, and your ranking against other promoters — all live.
pr_join_benefit3_desc: Automatic payout for every validated ticket. No paperwork, no shady negotiations. You see what you earn to the cent.
pr_join_benefit4_desc: You're not tied to one club. Work with whichever venue you want each night, or several at once. Your call.
pr_join_benefit5_desc: Every ticket carries a dynamic QR verifiable at the door. Your guest gets in smoothly and you earn the commission.
pr_join_benefit6_desc: No weird apps or desktop software. Your ticket generator runs from your mobile browser, anytime.
pr_join_how_subtitle: From zero to generating tickets in under 5 minutes
pr_join_step1_desc: Create your account with Google or email. No paperwork, no fees, no lock-in.
pr_join_step2_desc: We assign you a personal sales link for each available event or venue. Share it wherever you want.
pr_join_step3_desc: Every guest who enters through your link is attributed to you. Commissions settled automatically.
pr_join_diff_free1: You go freelance: pick your venue and event each night
pr_join_diff_free2: Your own link, your metrics, your commissions
pr_join_diff_free3: You don't depend on any venue's structure
pr_join_diff_free4: You can work with multiple venues at once
pr_join_diff_venue2: Terms and commissions set by management
pr_join_diff_venue3: Access only to the venue panel that hired them
pr_join_diff_venue4: Managed from the venue's Custom Mode
pr_join_cta_subtitle: Register for free, get your link and start generating tickets in minutes. No paperwork, no commitment.
